summary: Patterns can include variables passed with -e, such as webservers:!{{ excluded }}:&{{ required }}.
questions: Can I pass a group name into hosts: from the command line?
How do I use variables in host patterns?

answer_card.title: Variables in patterns
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
hosts: webservers:!{{ excluded }}:&{{ required }}
```
Then pass the groups with `-e`, for example `ansible-playbook site.yml -e 'excluded=atlanta required=staging'`.
